task_not_ready: ❌ Task %s is not ready to be prepared yet. You may need to check the task status or wait until it is available for preparation. You can use other Spec Wizard commands, such as 'wz info %s' to get more details about this task.
arch_mode_plan_loaded: 📐 [ARCHITECTURE MODE] Technical plan for Task %s loaded.
error_reading_spec: ❌ Error reading TASK SPEC for Task %s.
agent_instruction_prepare: ⚠️ INSTRUCTION FOR AI AGENT: You have just read the TECHNICAL CONTRACT. DO NOT implement anything yet. Confirm only that you understood the requirements and the architecture. The actual implementation MUST ONLY START when the user sends the command 'wz code %s'.
agent_instruction_code: You are the DEVELOPER (Athlete Agent). Your mission is to implement the code by STRICTLY FOLLOWING the 'technical_spec' provided above. DO NOT invent new features beyond what is specified in the technical contract. When finished, you MUST run 'wz audit %s' to validate your delivery.
help_roadmap: - roadmap (or status): Displays the current status of tasks and sprints.
help_skills: - skills: Displays Golden Rules and technical guidelines (skills.md).
help_sync: - sync: Synchronizes ROADMAP.md with internal system state.
help_init: - init [lang] [name] [stack] [path]: Initializes Spec Wizard folders and files.
help_info: - info <id>: JSON technical details of a specific task.
help_goal: - goal <id>: Retrieves the original instruction (User Story) of the task.
help_refine: - refine <id>: Generates the technical TASK SPEC (architect blueprint).
help_prepare: - prepare <id>: Validates if the task is ready for coding (Checklist).
help_code: - code <id>: (or build) Starts coding ONLY if everything is prepared.
help_audit: - audit <id> [--sprint <sid>]: Starts the formal task audit process.
help_state: - state: Shortcut to view state JSON (sprints/tasks).
error_no_cmd: Error: No command provided. Use 'wz help' to see the command list.
error_unknown_action: Error: Unknown action '%s'. Use info, goal, refine, prepare, code or audit.
error_unknown_cmd: Error: Command '%s' not recognized. Use 'wz help' to see the command list.
init_success:
✅ Project '%s' successfully initialized at %s!
🚀 ROADMAP.md generated and agent rules injected.
📝 Registration Status: %s
init_error_home:
⚠️ You are trying to initialize a project in your HOME folder (`/home/john`).
This usually happens when the editor is opened without a project folder selected.

Please open the project folder in the editor or provide the explicit path: `wz_init en "Name" stack path`.
init_error_exists: ⚠️ The folder `.spec-wizard` already exists in `%s`. To restart the project, remove it manually before running `wz_init` again.
blocked_blind_flight:
🛑 BLOCKED: 'Blind flight' attempt detected!

You cannot code task %s without a technical TASK SPEC.

Please execute first:
1. wz goal %s (Understand goal)
2. wz refine %s (Technical refinement)
3. wz prepare %s (Validate readiness)
error_sprints_not_found: ❌ Error: sprints.json not found. Run 'wz sync' first.
task_status_detail: Task %s ("%s") is currently with status **"%s"** and is not ready for preparation. Acceptance criteria have not yet been met:
recommendation_title: To prepare this task, you probably need to complete previous tasks first. I recommend:
recommendation_roadmap: 1. Check the general roadmap with `wz roadmap` to see the task sequence
recommendation_info: 2. Check the status of previous tasks with `wz info <id>`
recommendation_setup: 3. Ensure that the base project is configured before implementing the functionality
prepare_retry_msg: You can try preparing again after completing the necessary dependencies. Would you like me to check the roadmap or the status of other tasks?
status_inconsistency: ⚠️ There are roadmap items without corresponding tasks
hint_refine: Technical specification has not been generated yet. Use 'wz refine %s' to define the contract.
hint_prepare: Task is ready but not prepared. Use 'wz prepare %s' to load the context.
hint_code: Task files have not been detected yet. Use 'wz code %s' to start implementation.
hint_audit: Tests or acceptance criteria failed. Use 'wz audit %s' to validate the implementation.
hint_inconsistency: Synchronize the project with 'wz sync' to correct discrepancies between roadmap and tasks.
help_sync_task: - sync-task <id> [--status <s>] [--bugs <b>] [--notes <n>]: Manually sync task state (internal/IA use).
help_configure_mcp: - configure-mcp: Configures the MCP server in the project config file.
help_clear_omniroute_cache: - clear-omniroute-cache: Clears the OmniRoute cache (ghost records).
help_feed_sliding_window: - feed-sliding-window <prompt> <response>: Feeds the sliding window with recent interactions.
help_update_macro_resume: - update-macro-resume <last-action>: Updates the macro task summary.
help_assemble_slim_prompt: - assemble-slim-prompt <user-prompt> <target-file>: Assembles a slim prompt for the AI.
help_slim_prompt: - slim-prompt <user-prompt> <target-file>: Executes all commands to assemble a slim prompt.
